capabilities: Sync Discord channel messages into Markdown notes
Fetch only messages added since the last sync
Retry requests that hit Discord rate limits
Organize attachments by channel and by file type
disambiguation: Sync runs one way only: messages are pulled from Discord into notes, and nothing is posted back to Discord.
extras: Bot token is stored in data.json inside the plugin folder; the plugin ID changed from discord-to-obsidian in v0.2.0, so existing users must copy data.json to the new folder; only regular text channels are synced, forum and thread channels are skipped; install via BRAT or by copying build files until it is in the community store.
problem: Discord conversations stay outside the vault, and Discord CDN attachment links expire, so messages and files cannot be kept or searched in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: install BRAT, add bicybert/discord-to-obsidian, and it will pull every new GitHub release automatically

summary: Syncs Discord channel messages into vault notes, one note per channel with a heading per message and attachments saved locally.
